uwp_capture_status: partial: UWP app launched successfully (Release, PID 24284, window 'Background Tasks C# Sample') and was screenshotted. Per-scenario navigation could not be automated: the legacy UWP CoreWindow exposes no UIA subtree (winapp ui inspect returns only a top-level Pane), and coordinate-driven clicks did not advance the ListBox selection, so every saved frame shows the scenario-list landing view with Scenario 1 selected. All six scenarios are visible in the list; Scenario 1's controls (Register enabled, Unregister disabled, status 'Unregistered') are captured as functional ground truth.

features.name: Background Task (system event)
features.description: Registers/unregisters a background task for the Time Zone Change system event. Register enables the task; Unregister removes it; a status line reflects Registered/Unregistered plus progress/completion.
expected_behaviour: Selecting scenario 1 shows a Description, a Register button (enabled), an Unregister button (disabled), and a status TextBlock reading 'Unregistered'.
Clicking Register registers the task, enables Unregister, disables Register, and updates status to 'Registered'.
Clicking Unregister reverses the state back to 'Unregistered'.

features.name: Background Task with Condition
features.description: Registers a background task that runs on the Time Zone Change event only while an internet-available condition holds.
expected_behaviour: Register button registers the conditional task and updates the status to 'Registered'.
Unregister button removes it and returns status to 'Unregistered'.

features.name: Servicing Complete Task
features.description: Registers a task triggered by the ServicingComplete maintenance trigger.
expected_behaviour: Register registers the ServicingComplete task and updates status to 'Registered'.
Unregister removes it and returns status to 'Unregistered'.

features.name: Background Task with Time Trigger
features.description: Requests background access then registers a task on a 15-minute TimeTrigger.
expected_behaviour: Register requests background access and registers a TimeTrigger task, updating status to 'Registered'.
Unregister removes it and returns status to 'Unregistered'.

features.name: Background Task with Application Trigger
features.description: Registers an ApplicationTrigger task and lets the app signal it on demand, showing the task result.
expected_behaviour: Register registers the ApplicationTrigger task; status becomes 'Registered'.
A 'Signal Background Task' action triggers the task and the result/progress is displayed.
Unregister removes it and returns status to 'Unregistered'.

features.name: Grouped Background Task
features.description: Registers a task inside a BackgroundTaskRegistrationGroup and offers separate unregister of grouped vs ungrouped tasks.
expected_behaviour: Register registers a grouped task; status becomes 'Registered'.
Unregister (grouped) removes the grouped task; a separate action unregisters ungrouped tasks.
